summary: AAR CORP. filed an 8-K announcing the completion of its acquisition of Aircraft Reconfig Technologies LLC from ZIM Aircraft Cabin Solutions LLC for $35 million in cash, subject to post-closing adjustments. The deal, entered into on December 17, 2025, was executed by AAR's wholly-owned subsidiary, AAR Aircraft Services, Inc. The acquisition adds FAA Organization Designation Authorization and engineering capabilities for passenger aircraft reconfiguration. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The transaction was all-cash, with no regulatory clock noted. Watch for integration of ODA authority and potential certification revenue synergies; limited arbitrage as deal is closed.
